fallback: 250ms deadline; same-scope approved cache or empty injection
concurrency: host session IDs scoped by adapter and persona; no mutable latent sharing
context_signals: previous-turn tool names and error count (after_tool_call; never params or results), run channel, declared context (OPENAPE_CONTEXT); current user message only with OPENAPE_CONTEXT_TEXT=local, classified locally and never sent
unverified: derived turn context against a real OpenClaw run (after_tool_call signals)
subagents: heartbeat, cron and non-user triggers opt out
